lore: One light may burn over the save log at a time. The harbour hands the light from keeper to keeper by the hourglass, but every keeper's glass runs fast or slow, and now and then a keeper nods off between reading the glass and writing the log. Trust the glass alone and two lights burn at once. Only the numbered brass tokens, rising with every hand-over, let the harbour turn away a keeper who woke too late.

lines.start: One light at a time over the save log. Choose how the harbour hands it over.
lines.handover: The glass is empty. The light passes to the next keeper.
lines.fenced: Your token is older than the harbour's. Go back to sleep, old keeper.
lines.win: Never two lights at once. Every stale keeper was turned away.
lines.fail: Two lights burned and the log took both. Number the tokens.
